verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing supports rule-like automation for card events: spending controls block merchant categories/countries/limits automatically, and the synchronous webhook lets custom code approve/decline authorizations in real time based on developer-defined logic, with ML risk scores feeding those decisions. This is automatic action-on-event but confined to card authorization events rather than a general-purpose rule/trigger engine spanning arbitrary events and actions. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader rule-definition UI/engine beyond spending controls, support for non-authorization events, and any AI-native/agent-specific rule automation beyond risk scoring.
